description: Land Acquisition - Halminiya in Sheet Nos. 180, 178, 179 & 200 Laggala-Pallegama D/S  Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters. There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and the subject matter is specifically land-related rather than falling under other specialized categories.
